source: day 2: a repo session fixing my PR asked twice whether to address the bot review comments now or wait for the human reviewers. That is a question for me, not outreach: it goes into the report's open points (or to me directly when I am at the window). Waiting for the reviewers themselves is the my-pr item's awaiting-review state and its nudge rule. A substitution in outreach text is refused like in delegate.
setup: bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#112' changes-requested --note '5 bot threads'
bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#112' addressing --note 'fix-my-pr delegated to exporter-tax'
bosun ledger record-delegation 'mypr:acme/exporter#112' --window exporter-tax --task fix-my-pr --ask 'address the bot review threads'

steps.why: the decision for me goes in the report, not into outreach
steps.run: bosun ledger report 'mypr:acme/exporter#112' --summary 'Fixed 3 of 5 bot threads; 2 are style-only' --result https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/112 --open 'decide: address the 2 style-only bot threads now, or wait for the human reviewers'

steps.why: the open point reaches me through the reports
out: open:    decide: address the 2 style-only bot threads now

steps.why: outreach text that would run a command is refused
the reviewers' wait is the PR's own state
steps.run: bosun ledger transition 'mypr:acme/exporter#112' awaiting-review --note 'fixes pushed; waiting for Lena' --field last_push_at=2026-03-13T09:00:00Z

mypr:acme/exporter#112.report_open: decide: address the 2 style-only bot threads now, or wait for the human reviewers
